login.title: Sign in to manage your wedding
login.intro: Enter the e-mail address listed as an administrator of your wedding website. We will send a one-time code to it. You do not need a password.
login.email.label: E-mail
login.email.hint: We will send a six-digit code to this address.
login.error.invalidEmail: Enter a valid e-mail address, for example klara@example.com.
login.error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
code.title: Enter the code from your e-mail
code.intro: If this e-mail address is listed as an administrator of a wedding, we have sent a six-digit code to it. The code is valid for 10 minutes and can be used only once.
code.label: Six-digit code
code.hint: You can paste the code from your clipboard. If you cannot see the e-mail, check your spam folder.
code.error.format: The code has six digits. Please check it.
code.error.wrong: The code is incorrect or no longer valid. Check it, or request a new one.
code.error.expired: Your sign-in has expired. Please request a new code.
link.title: Confirm sign-in
link.body: Select the button to sign in to your wedding management. The link is valid for 10 minutes and can be used only once.
link.invalid.title: This link is no longer valid
link.invalid.body: The link is invalid, has expired or has already been used. Please request a new code.
link.error.wrong: This link is no longer valid. Please request a new code.
pin.title: Sign in with a PIN
pin.intro: Enter the address of your wedding website and the management PIN. We announce every PIN sign-in to the backup e-mail.
pin.slug.label: Wedding website address
pin.slug.hint: The part before .se-vezmou.cz, for example emma-and-thomas.
pin.pin.label: Management PIN
pin.pin.hint: At least six digits. You can paste the PIN from your clipboard.
pin.emailLink: Sign in with a code from e-mail
pin.error.invalid: The address or the PIN is incorrect.
pin.error.locked: PIN entry is temporarily paused. Try again in {pause} or sign in with a code from e-mail.
logout.title: Sign out
logout.body: Do you really want to sign out of your wedding management?
backup.title: Confirm the backup e-mail
backup.body: Someone listed {email} as the backup e-mail of a wedding website. If you know about this, confirm it with the button. You will then receive notices about sign-ins and access changes.
backup.done: Done, the backup e-mail is confirmed. Notices will be sent to this address. You can close this page.
backup.invalid.title: This link is no longer valid
backup.invalid.body: The link is invalid or expired, the address is already confirmed, or the backup e-mail has changed since.
backup.invalid.next: If you want to confirm the address, ask the couple to enter your address as the backup e-mail again in the website management (Access section). You will get a new link.
